segments.summary: Reviewed dashboard and project-entry controls; recorded the explicit concept-only boundary and the Open Folder accessible-name gap.
Reviewed repeated project Open, Settings, Archive, and Remove controls; preserved their lineage-only status and flagged the unresolved destructive Remove lifecycle.
Reviewed Project Settings and early wizard navigation; confirmed fixture exclusion and found explicit modal role and keyboard-parity gaps.
Reviewed terminal wizard navigation and project/requirements intake; identified explicit command-or-retirement blockers and missing untrusted-file intake semantics.
Reviewed provider/model selectors, interview-start controls, and binder pills; found unassigned transition effects and explicit custom-control accessibility gaps.
Reviewed resubmission, provider/model, numeric, checkbox, and interview navigation controls; found numeric validation and resubmission lifecycle gaps.
Reviewed PRD review fixtures and the production-wired approval control; captured its command, certification, and accessibility contracts plus missing multi-effect failure semantics.
Reviewed plan-compile provider, model, effort, output, and approval-policy selectors; preserved their owner-adjudicated boundary and identified the missing Auto-approve authority contract.
